fusions.name: Crouch Then Spring
fusions.desc: You rush up to 6 tiles to the target and bite. The bite deals 13 damage and leaves it 12% easier to wound for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Borrowed Hiss
fusions.desc: A hiss carries 3 tiles ahead of you. It deals 4 resonating damage to everything in it, with a 30% chance to leave each target [Hindered] for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Still in Long Grass
fusions.desc: Veils you for 6 seconds: enemies notice you 60% later, you move 11% faster, and the veil breaks the moment you attack.

fusions.name: Flinch Before the Strike
fusions.desc: Once every 10 seconds, a dodge that fails is rolled again, and the second roll stands.
